dedupe_keys.name: azerbaijan transport and energy infrastructure lengths railways metro oil and gas trunk pipelines roads annual 1995 2024 state statistics committee

description: State Statistics Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan Respublikasının Dövlət Statistika Komitəsi) publishes one annual national table of infrastructure lengths in kilometres: railways (total, public, electrified, non-public; 2,419 km in 2024), metro track (double-track count), trunk pipelines (main oil pipelines with the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan and Sangachal-Supsa lines and other local lines; main gas pipelines with the Baku-Tbilisi-Erzurum line and other local lines) and roads (republic and local roads with the paved share; 80,320 km in the 2024 row); the portal has a sibling table on the fixed assets of transport infrastructure. Coverage: Azerbaijan nationally, 30 annual rows from 1995 to 2024; the portal record was modified on 2025-12-22. Format and access: a CSV file, free and without registration from the Azerbaijan open data portal; the portal catalogue is queryable through a public CKAN API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero (CC0, as shown by the portal); cost: free. Caveats: national totals only, with no network geometry or condition data; the column headers are in Azerbaijani, pipeline columns give total and operating lengths without routes, and the sibling fixed-assets table was not opened. Simulation uses: national infrastructure stock and growth inputs to long-run transport and energy network scenarios and for scaling asset inventories. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
